selection.effort_confirmation: Require repeated positive Medium-to-XHigh quality gain; single-run gaps remain candidates.
selection.maturity_definition: Application evaluation is mature when model discrimination has at least 2 confirmed task families and reasoning-effort behavior has at least 1 confirmed cross-instance family.
selection.effort_core_definition: Effort Core accepts either a repeated positive Medium-to-XHigh discriminator or a repeated cross-instance effort-sensitivity signal with quality spread >= the configured threshold. Sensitivity is not interpreted as higher effort always being better.
selection.effort_family_confirmation: Across >=3 paired variants, require >=2 independent repeat rounds per variant per effort, repeated non-confounded quality separation, and >=2 signal-bearing variants. Different variant IDs are not repeated trials. Do not promote one-shot family spreads.

efficiency.confirmation: Treat a single run as an efficiency candidate only; require repeated directionally consistent runs before confirmation.
